frozen_design: AutoML4Clust/utils/dataset_loader.py::LoadedDataset.get_record returns (partition_space, evaluation_space) and documents that the evaluation space is ALWAYS the full 2-D space. AutoClust/indomain/dataset.py builds ViewMetricEngine(config_root, partition, evaluation), so historically the decision space is the view and the evaluation space is the full 2-D matrix.
central_routing: ViewMetricEngine._clustopt_raw calls evaluator.evaluate(labels, X_decision, X_full, ...) and GenericCVIEvaluator dispatches per metric on metric.space. Routing is CENTRAL, not metric-specific.

candidate_scoring_routing.note: proven by poisoning X_view and X_full to disjoint widths and value ranges and reading the matrix off wrapped metric objects

The scoring-layer tests use an xy_2d fixture where X_view == X_full, and the component-equivalence evidence compared adapter against reference over the SAME engine, so its result is matrix-agnostic and its claim stands as written

classification.label: INTENTIONAL AUXILIARY-SPACE SEMANTICS
classification.evidence: AutoML4Clust/utils/dataset_loader.py::get_record documents that the evaluation space is ALWAYS the full 2-D space, and AutoClust/indomain/dataset.py passes (partition, evaluation) into ViewMetricEngine. Candidate partitions are generated in the view space; metrics declaring space="full" are then evaluated on the full 2-D evaluation space by frozen design. This is a documented mixture, not accidental cross-view scoring.
classification.secondary_finding: the Stage-4 autoclust_scoring API defaults X_full to X_decision, which would silently degrade this V2 design into V3 cross-view scoring on 1-D views if a caller omits it. No committed evidence is affected; the hazard is latent and matters for the Stage 4B-4 common runner.

proposed_common_runner_invariant: every physical trace and scorer must receive an explicit scientific view identity AND the two matrices bound to it (view/decision and full/evaluation). ClustOpt already satisfies this; ML2DAC now requires X_full; AutoClust still defaults it.
